description: This is a Python script for generating a bank reconciliation statement report in the ERPNext system, including functions to fetch and process financial data related to bank accounts, journal entries, and payments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the bank reconciliation statement data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches journal entries, payment entries, and POS transactions related to the account.

methods.name: get_amounts_not_reflected_in_system
methods.description: Calculates amounts not reflected in the system for the report date.

methods.name: get_balance_row
methods.description: Creates a balance row for the report with label and amount.
